Jade_Irelia.name: Irelia
Jade_Irelia.title: The Will of the Blades
Jade_Irelia.lore: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions.
Jade_Irelia.blurb: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions.

spells.name: Bladesurge
spells.description: Irelia dashes to strike her target. If it kills, Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes and refunds some of its Mana cost.
spells.tooltip:
Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

If Bladesurge kills her target, its cooldown refreshes and Irelia restores {{ manareturn }} Mana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hiten Style
spells.description:
Passive: Irelia's attacks restore Health.

Active: Irelia's attacks deal bonus true damage and restore more Health for a few seconds.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Irelia's basic attacks restore {{ health }} health.

Active: Irelia's basic attacks deal {{ damage }} true damage and now restore {{ healthrestoreactive }} health for {{ activeduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Equilibrium Strike
spells.description: Irelia's attack balances the scales, dealing damage and slowing her target. If they have a higher Health % than her, the blow stuns them instead.
spells.tooltip:
Irelia pierces her target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ stunduration }} second(s).

If the target has a higher Health % than Irelia, she Stuns them for the duration instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Transcendent Blades
spells.description: Irelia summons 4 spirit blades that she can fling to damage and siphon life from enemies they pass through.
spells.tooltip: Irelia summons 4 spirit blades that she can fling to deal <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to enemies they pass through. She <healing>heals</healing> for {{ championhealpercent }}% of the damage dealt against champions and {{ minionhealpercent }}% against other enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.description: Irelia gains Tenacity for each nearby enemy champion.
